text_block_list.text:
I have to commit the sight of Эйсин Флэш
running
to my mind.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I silently begin to do so as the final
summer camp
begins, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Sure. I have a question, though...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Trainer, are you watching me?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: Of course. I'm your trainer, aren't I?

text_block_list.text:
No, not in that sense. There is clearly
something
bothering you.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
If something is concerning you, please
tell me as
it is.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
And just like that, she's seen right
through me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
You wish to imprint the sight of me
running into
your memory? But why?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: Because I like the way you run.

text_block_list.text:
The sight of her running was what made
me want
to be her trainer in the first
place.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I tell her how watching her run made me
want to
support her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: But why is that?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I don't believe my running style is
particularly
outstanding compared to
anyone else's.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: You don't know the reason?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Intuition, is it?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
You've come a long way on nothing but
a
baseless feeling, haven't you?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Everything I've felt on this journey with
her has
done nothing but reassure me
that becoming her
trainer that day was
my own "right" decision.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
You were brilliant at the Osaka Hai and the
Spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure how valid that statement is,
but... I
am confident that I ran well in
them.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I might have completely fallen apart on
my own.
It was thanks to you that I was
able to see my
schedule to the end.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: We've come this far on the right path together.

text_block_list.text:
Is it not too early to say such a thing?
You speak
as if everything is coming to
an end—
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
To make a schedule is to create a
definitive end
to something.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
That is decided from the start. So why
am I...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
